name: Undead Strings
source:
Unleash the power of rock in our rhythm-visual novel game, Undead Strings! 

Join Liberty, the fierce guitarist, and her rebel band mate Rob as they battle an evil witch who's took your band mates sister captive! Embark on a high-voltage adventure through the realm of monsters, armed with hardcore music and determination. What horrors will we face in the realm of the unknown?

[From [url=https://oakgravestudio.itch.io/undead-strings]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在我们的节奏视觉小说游戏《Undead Strings》中释放摇滚的力量！

加入凶猛的吉他手Liberty和她的叛逆乐队伙伴Rob的行列，与邪恶的女巫战斗，她俘虏了你乐队成员的妹妹！带着硬核音乐和决心，踏上怪物王国的高压冒险之旅。在未知的领域，我们将面临怎样的恐怖？

[来自[url=https://oakgravestudio.itch.io/undead-strings]itch.io[/url]]
